desc: This Switch was posted by anand_4957. Tagged with: switch, red, text, off, minimal, toggle, switch, round, inactive.
html:
<label class="switch">
  <input class="switch__input" type="checkbox" role="switch" />
  <svg
    class="switch__letters"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    width="24px"
    height="24px"
    aria-hidden="true"
  >
    <g
      stroke="currentcolor"
      stroke-linecap="round"
      stroke-width="4"
      transform="translate(0,4)"
    >
      <g class="switch__letter">
        <polyline class="switch__letter-stroke" points="2 2,2 14"></polyline>
        <polyline
          class="switch__letter-stroke"
          points="2 2,16 2"
          stroke-dasharray="14 16"
          stroke-dashoffset="8"
          transform="rotate(0,2,2)"
        ></polyline>
        <polyline
          class="switch__letter-stroke"
          points="2 8,6 8"
          stroke-dasharray="4 6"
        ></polyline>
      </g>
      <g class="switch__letter" transform="translate(14,0)">
        <polyline class="switch__letter-stroke" points="2 2,2 14"></polyline>
        <polyline
          class="switch__letter-stroke"
          points="2 2,8 2"
          stroke-dasharray="6 8"
        ></polyline>
        <polyline
          class="switch__letter-stroke"
          points="2 8,6 8"
          stroke-dasharray="4 6"
        ></polyline>
      </g>
    </g>
  </svg>
</label>
